scope: 28 supplied English PNG cards for existing notes; original asset bytes and detailed note bodies retained. Only fisher-quant and pacevggt H1 titles follow revised source titles.
review_method: Read original-paper HTML abstracts, methods, result-table labels and limitations; cross-checked card numeric tokens against the same-revision original PDFs and recorded physical PDF page numbers. Token presence alone does not establish metric attribution; dataset/protocol/table attribution is captured in the manual evidence review. Opened all supplied card images.
publication_policy: Reviewed assets are ready, not complete, until exact asset bytes and note links are verified on main. Publication is recorded separately after merge.
browser_verification: Unavailable in this execution environment; no claim of rendered GitHub desktop/mobile layout verification.
